aggregate_metrics: use the aggregate context manager to create a named aggregation scope for logging metrics
log_scalar_values: call log_scalar to record a weighted scalar value like loss under the active aggregation context
log_speed_rate: call log_speed to record the rate of a quantity per second under the active aggregation context
get_smoothed_values: call get_smoothed_values to retrieve all smoothed metric values aggregated under a given name
query_gpu_memory: call nvidia_smi_gpu_memory_stats to parse nvidia-smi output and return GPU memory usage in GB
